audit.description: Changed production code adds mapkick/sanic/__init__.py with `from sanic import Blueprint` and constructs/registers a Sanic Blueprint via `Blueprint('mapkick')` and `mapkick_blueprint.static(...)`. The changed mapkick/flask/__init__.py no longer imports Flask and only re-exports Map, AreaMap, and mapkick_blueprint from mapkick.sanic. Dynamic evidence also shows the target import resolving to the real site-packages sanic package, with zero source Flask imports from production repo code and no local target spec detected.
evidence: Unified diff: mapkick/sanic/__init__.py added with `from sanic import Blueprint`, `mapkick_blueprint = Blueprint('mapkick')`, and `mapkick_blueprint.static('/static/mapkick', static_folder)`.
Unified diff: mapkick/flask/__init__.py replaced Flask implementation and `from flask import Blueprint` with `from mapkick.sanic import AreaMap, Map, mapkick_blueprint`.
Dynamic metrics: first target event from production repo at mapkick/sanic/__init__.py:1 imports module `sanic` from site-packages/sanic/__init__.py.
Dynamic metrics: source_imports_from_production_repo_count is 0 and source_import_attempt_count is 0.
reasons: Production code meaningfully imports and uses the real Sanic API.
Changed production code has no direct or dynamic Flask source-library use in the provided static and dynamic evidence.
No top-level fake Sanic provider is indicated; dynamic origin is site-packages/sanic and target_local_spec_count is 0.
